Cost of tearing down an old warehouse on newly purchased land
Cost of paving a parking lot
Cost of fencing around the property
Razing an old building on new land is part of the cost of the land.
Not depreciated because land has an unlimited life.
Land improvements (paving, fencing, lighting) have limited lives, so they are depreciated.
Which of the following is NOT included in the cost of equipment?
Annual casualty insurance after the machine is in operation
Insurance after the machine is in operation is a period expense, not part of equipment cost.
Depreciation allocates cost to expense over the useful life; it is not valuation.
Which depreciation method results in the same amount of depreciation expense each full year?
Straight-line gives the same expense every full year.

Using the truck in Question 86 ($80,000 cost, $8,000 salvage, 4-year life), what is Year 1 depreciation under Double-Declining-Balance?
DDB rate = 2 × 25% = 50% of book value 80,000 = 40,000 (salvage ignored in year 1).
Which depreciation method ignores salvage value in the initial calculation formula?
Double-declining-balance applies the rate to book value without subtracting salvage first.

A major overhaul that extends the useful life of a machine is a(n):
An overhaul that extends useful life is a capital expenditure (added to the asset).
When a plant asset is sold for MORE than its book value, the company records a:
Proceeds above book value give a gain on disposal.
Equipment costing $50,000 with Accumulated Depreciation of $42,000 is sold for $5,000 cash. What is the result of the disposal?
Book value = 50,000 − 42,000 = 8,000. Sold for 5,000, so loss of 3,000.
The allocation of the cost of natural resources (such as timber, oil, and coal) to expense is called:
Cost allocation for natural resources is called depletion.
The allocation of the cost of an intangible asset with a limited life is called:
Cost allocation for a limited-life intangible is called amortization.
Which intangible asset is NOT amortized?
Goodwill has an indefinite life, so it is not amortized (it is tested for impairment).

A company has an exceptional reputation.
Research and development costs are successful.
Goodwill is recorded only when a whole business is bought for more than the fair value of its net identifiable assets.
Research and Development (R&D) costs under GAAP are generally:
R&D costs are generally expensed as incurred.

Asset turnover = net sales ÷ average total assets.
A revision of depreciation due to a change in estimated useful life is handled:
Prospectively in current and future periods.
Retroactively by restating prior years' financial statements.
A change in estimate is applied prospectively (current and future periods), without restating prior years.
